test_fsdp_memory_usage: test FSDP GPU memory usage across multiple iterations with DDP and FSDP configurations
create_model_with_fsdp: create a Model with FSDP wrapping, auto_wrap_bn, and optional checkpoint_wrapper on blocks
wrap_module_with_fsdp: wrap a PyTorch module with FSDP using to_fsdp and a process group config
